results.title: IDB Group and Japan Mark 50 Years of Partnership with International Business Forum and Historic Cooperation Package
results.description: The Inter-American Development Bank Group (IDB Group) and Japan celebrated 50 years of partnership today at the Japan-LAC Business Forum 2026.

results.title: Ex-NBA player who says he identifies as woman ejected from WNBA game
results.description: A former NBA player who says he now identifies as a woman is ejected from a WNBA game after an explosive confrontation with players.
